_comment: Advisories we have SEEN, JUDGED and DEFERRED - not ones we are ignoring.
scripts/audit-check.mjs fails CI on any high/critical advisory that is NOT
listed here, and ALSO fails once an entry's `until` date passes. That second
rule is the point of the file: a deferral has to be renewed deliberately, so
it cannot rot into a permanent exemption that nobody re-reads.
Adding an entry is a decision. Record why, and who has to do what to remove it.
EMPTY as of 2026-08-20, and that is worth a note. The one entry this file has
ever carried was sharp (GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj, high): the fix needed >=0.35, a
major bump of the rasteriser, and every published sheet's bytes are a product
guarantee. It was deferred until 2026-10-01 as part of the P1 block of
technical-audit_2026-08-19, and closed on 2026-08-20 - six weeks early, and by
doing the work rather than by extending the date. That is the file working as
designed rather than as somewhere to leave things.
